description: Searches French companies in the official INSEE-based national directory by name, SIREN or SIRET, optionally filtered by postal code and NAF activity code: SIREN, names, legal form, NAF activity, company category, headcount band, founding date, active or ceased status, number of establishments, head-office SIRET and address with coordinates, and the registered officers. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

naf.description: NAF/APE activity code filter such as 62.01Z

q.description: Company name, SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits), at least 3 characters
